summary: Fed officials signalled patience on further rate cuts as inflation cools slowly, keeping the rate outlook in focus for US stocks. Wall Street ended the week mixed with tech stocks weighing on the Nasdaq, Nvidia shares slipped after a report of tighter chip export rules, and Tesla deliveries beat estimates. In crypto, Bitcoin rose 1.12% to 121,350.42 dollars over 24 hours, and a separate headline reported a fifth straight day of Bitcoin ETF inflows.
story1_why: Signals about the pace of rate cuts shape borrowing costs and how investors value stocks across the market.
story2_why: Tighter export rules could limit where Nvidia can sell its chips.
crypto_note: Bitcoin was at 121,350.42 dollars, up 1.12% over 24 hours, while Ether was at 4,512.10 dollars, down 0.85%.
